prompts.skill1:
Use case: identity-preserve. Extend the exact unarmed Grimhald reference into FOUR complete full-body Stone Bulwark cast drawings, 2x2 equal square cells, right-facing three-quarter game view. This is the SAME original armoured warden, not a redesign: identical light-grey highlights and charcoal armour, crimson cloth, orange eye slit, crown-ridged closed helmet, slim proportions and neutral lighting. Match reference physical body scale and keep feet at one cell baseline. Transparent background.
A separate weapon accessory will be attached afterward. Draw NO axe or shaft and NO fissure or effects in these body frames. One closed gauntlet clearly supplies the future grip.
1 top-left: upright initial stance, right gauntlet near shoulder like reference.
2 top-right: raises both arms overhead preparing a powerful downward axe slam, complete knees/hips/chest moving together.
3 bottom-left: deep braced crouch, right gauntlet strikes down forward close to the ground, other hand stabilises the pose, helmet still connected to torso. Keep natural body scale rather than making crouch larger.
4 bottom-right: weight comes back up, right closed fist low-forward after the slam, cloth settles.
All four must be genuinely different whole-body drawings with fluid weight shift, same helmet size and same armour colours. Simple blocky game sprite style; no detailed textures, shading changes, sparks, aura, floor shadow, captions, grid lines or clipping. Preserve lots of transparent margin for a separate crescent axe.
prompts.skill2:
Use case: identity-preserve. FOUR complete full-body Skull Bash movement/cast frames of the EXACT Grimhald reference character. 2x2 equal square cells. All right-facing three-quarter game view, same neutral lighting, same pale-grey steel and charcoal armour, crimson cloth, orange visor, crown helmet, slim proportions and physical body scale. Do not enlarge crouched or lunging poses. Transparent background. NO weapon: a separate axe accessory is attached later.
Make a readable Alistar-like shoulder/head-first lunge, with connected knees/hips/torso and fluid weight:
1 top-left upright ready stance matching reference, closed right fist near shoulder and left near belt.
2 top-right lowers his head and centre of gravity forward, back leg loads the push, arms tighten behind the shoulders.
3 bottom-left full forward shoulder-first charge with torso diagonal, one leg extended back and front knee driving forward, helmet crown clearly recognisable, hands tucked alongside torso. This is an aggressive ground headbutt, not a flying Superman pose.
4 bottom-right recovery: front foot braces and weight comes back up, arms return to ready.
Keep boots on one baseline per cell (charge can have rear boot lifted). Same helmet size, armour plate shapes, colour values and line thickness in every frame. Simple blocky game-size art. No dust, trails, impacts, aura, floor shadow, text, borders or cropping.
prompts.ult:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make FOUR complete full-body Warden's Verdict axe-throw windup/release drawings for the exact Grimhald in reference. 2x2 equal square cells. Same right-facing three-quarter game camera, neutral lighting, light-grey steel highlights, charcoal plate, crimson cloth, amber visor, crown-ridged helmet, slim proportions and constant character scale. Transparent background.
The axe is added separately later, so draw NO weapon, shaft, projectile, trail or effect. Keep a clearly drawn closed throwing gauntlet.
1 top-left upright shoulder-ready stance like reference, right fist near shoulder, left fist near belt.
2 top-right rotates torso back and raises throwing fist high behind/above helmet, knees load the throw.
3 bottom-left full forward overhead throwing extension: right arm extended forward/up, body weight moves onto front leg. Whole legs, hips and chest participate naturally.
4 bottom-right empty-handed follow-through and recovery, right arm coming down forward, left hand balances. The axe has now left him, so there must be no weapon or floating prop.
Keep the same body height/helmet size as reference; do not scale poses to fill a cell. Feet share a fixed baseline. Four distinct coherent fluid poses, complete connected anatomy, simple blocky readable game artwork. No extra character details, no spotlight, no texture noise, no floor shadow, grid, captions or clipping.
prompts.dead:
Use case: identity-preserve. SIX complete full-body death/fall animation drawings for EXACT Grimhald from the supplied unarmed idle reference. Arrange 3 columns by 2 rows, equal square cells, transparent background. Same right-facing three-quarter game camera, unchanged armour/helmet design, pale grey steel highlights, charcoal, crimson cloth and orange visor, same neutral lighting and constant physical body proportions. Do NOT stretch fallen bodies to upright height.
No weapon, props or effects. A fluid heavy armoured collapse:
1 top-left: standing hit recoil, head tilts back, chest pulls back and knees soften, both arms react (also usable as one-frame hit reaction).
2 top-middle: knees buckle and body sinks lower, one hand goes toward the floor.
3 top-right: drops to one knee, torso tips sideways, crimson cloth follows.
4 bottom-left: falls onto side, legs fold, hand lands on ground.
5 bottom-middle: nearly lying on side, helmet low, body and cloth settle.
6 bottom-right: final complete sideways corpse, motion ended, orange eye light dimmed but armour still has the same readable lighting.
Keep one floor baseline in each cell, ample transparent margins for horizontal fallen poses. The FIRST frame must be normal standing scale matching the reference, not enlarged. All later frames keep its exact head and limb scale. Clear blocky game silhouette, complete connected anatomy, no cutout-separated parts. No gore, shadows, floor, captions, grid, aura, sparks or cropping.
prompts.dead_alpha: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact six-frame 3x2 Grimhald death sprite sheet. Remove the ENTIRE white/checkered background and replace it with genuine alpha=0 transparency, including all empty spaces between legs, arms and armour. The checkerboard is NOT part of the artwork. Preserve all six complete character drawings, exact dimensions 1536x1024, original layout, all armour/cloth/eye colours, pixel outlines, poses, physical scale and positions. Do not redesign, relight, shrink or smooth the character. No added shadows, effects or labels. Output actual transparent PNG, not a drawn checkerboard.
prompts.axe: Use case: precise-object-edit. Extract ONLY Grimhald's exact approved crescent axe from reference image 1. Output a single isolated complete axe on true transparency, no character, hands, helmet, cloth or other objects. Preserve the weapon's own silhouette and palette: huge asymmetric curved grey crescent head on the LEFT, three angular iron braces and small amber inlays, brown wooden haft extending diagonally right/down to an iron pommel. Match precisely the weapon he carries over his shoulder in the top-left reference cell. The long wooden grip must be clean and uninterrupted after removing hands/body. Neutral light-grey/charcoal shading and simple blocky outlines, no glow, texture noise, sparks, shadow or background. Keep the complete weapon with generous transparent margins; no text. This is an accessory isolation, not a new weapon design.

notes: Approved appearance extended to complete whole-body drawings. Rigid transforms apply only to the separately isolated approved axe. AI generation is not deterministic; frozen source extraction/packing is reproducible.
